functions.name: ProcessSessionEventQueue
functions.summary: Event-queue processor for a game session state machine running in phase 4. Increments two float timer accumulators by the global dbl_8AFE98, then walks up to 10 entries of the current event queue (this+0x88) and dispatches each on its action type: 2 = probabilistic (random-vs-probability) defer or advance with optional physics init; 3 = execute a per-sub-type action (player-vehicle toggles, session phase dispatch, message display, car-selection handoff, session-phase transition to 5); 4 = settle (engine guard init, timer reset, requeue or delegate, else exit). Returns the current session phase; several paths set it to -1 to terminate.

operations.description: Gate: only run when the session phase *this equals 4 (event-processing phase); otherwise skip the whole body and return the current phase.
Increment float timer accumulators this+0x9C and this+0x98 by the global double dbl_8AFE98 on every invocation.
If the current event queue entry pointer this+0x88 is null, set the session phase *this to -1 and return.
Iterate over at most 10 event entries (v16 counter from 0, increment-then-test while < 10). Each pass re-reads the current entry pointer this+0x88.
Dispatch on the current event's action type (this+0xA8, aliasing entry+40) through jump table jpt_40DF5A. Non-2/3/4 action types return the current phase immediately.

Action type 2: when the entry timer (entry+24) is greater than 0, draw a value from RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator, multiply it by 0.000030518509 and compare the result against the entry probability float (entry+12).

Action type 2 branch: if the scaled random value is >= the probability, set the entry action type to 4 (advance); otherwise, if the entry sub-type equals 10, call PhysicsConfigInit(this+5), then set the entry action type to 3. Either way decrement the entry timer (entry+24), clamping at 0.
Action type 2 fallback: when the entry timer (entry+24) is not > 0, set the entry action type to 4 (advance). This path is also reached from sub-type 9 (alias to the same advance label).
Action type 3: if the entry delay (entry+16) still exceeds the accumulated timer this+0x9C, return the current phase without progressing this entry.
Action type 3: dispatch on the event sub-type (this+0xAC, aliasing entry+36) through jump table jpt_40E006.
Sub-type 2: if the session object this+0x4 is null, set the phase to -1 and return; else set the byte at session+36 to 1, set the byte flag this+0xA0 to 1, and advance the entry action type to 4.

Sub-type 3: if the session object this+0x4 is null, set the phase to -1 and return; if the flag this+0xA0 is set, clear the byte at session+36 to 0; then clear the flag this+0xA0 and advance the entry action type to 4.
Sub-type 4: if the session object this+0x4 is non-null, call SessionPhaseDispatchWithCascadeChecks(this[1], entry+44, 1); advance the entry action type to 4 and continue the loop.
Sub-type 5: if the session object this+0x4 is non-null, call SetPlayerVehicleIndex(entry+44); advance the entry action type to 4 and continue the loop.
Sub-type 6: store the entry payload (entry+44) into this+0x90, advance the entry action type to 4, and continue the loop.
Sub-type 7: select a message-display action on the entry payload (entry+44).

Sub-type 7 variants, one per payload value: 0 -> DisplayMessage0x151(&dword_5EB978); 1 -> sub_41C440(&dword_5EB978); 2 -> PositionBasedMessageDisplay(0); 3 -> PitRaceStatusMessageDispatcher(&dword_5EB978); 4 -> DisplayMessage0x202(&dword_5EB978). All variants (and the default) then advance the entry action type to 4.
Sub-type 10 (0xA): call CarSelectionStateMachine(this+5); if it returns zero, return the current phase; otherwise advance the entry action type to 4.
Sub-type 11 (0xB): advance the entry action type to 4 and return the current phase.
Sub-type 12 (0xC): transition the session phase *this to 5 (car selection), advance the entry action type to 4, and continue the loop.
Default branch of the sub-type dispatch: return the current session phase.

Action type 4 (settle): if the entry sub-type equals 10, call EngineGuardedInitializer(this+5); if the byte at entry+32 is non-zero, reset the timer this+0x9C to 0; if the entry timer (entry+24) is still > 0, set the entry action type back to 2 (requeue); otherwise call ConditionalDelegation(this) and if it returns false set the phase to -1 and return.
Default branch of the action-type dispatch and the terminal fall-through: return the current session phase.
